changelog:
- Initial release of the employee-engagement-survey skill.
- Generates complete employee engagement surveys with customizable questions, response scales, and an opening anonymity statement.
- Offers both survey design and analysis modes based on user input.
- Provides a detailed analysis framework including benchmarks, strengths/weaknesses, action planning, and communication templates.
- Includes built-in quality checks and anti-patterns to ensure survey effectiveness and data integrity.
summary: Design an employee engagement survey and analyse results. Use when asked to create an employee survey, engagement questionnaire, pulse survey, or eNPS survey...
